syllabus.description: Comprehensive German curriculum from absolute beginner (A1) through intermediate (B1), equivalent to approximately 4 university semesters.

A1.description: Can understand and use familiar everyday expressions and very basic phrases. Can introduce themselves and ask/answer personal questions.

A2.description: Can understand sentences and frequently used expressions related to immediate relevance. Can communicate in simple, routine tasks.

B1.description: Can understand main points of clear standard input on familiar matters. Can deal with most travel situations. Can produce simple connected text on familiar topics.

assessment_rubric.vocab_recall: User can translate target vocab in both directions without hints.
assessment_rubric.vocab_production: User can use target vocab correctly in self-generated sentences.
assessment_rubric.grammar_accuracy: User can produce 3+ grammatically correct sentences using the target structure without prompting.
assessment_rubric.comprehension: User can read/hear a short paragraph using lesson content and answer questions about it.
assessment_rubric.free_production: User can write a short paragraph (4-6 sentences) on the lesson topic using target vocab and grammar naturally.
assessment_rubric.mastery_note: A lesson is considered mastered when the user scores >= 0.8 across all dimensions. Lessons below 0.6 should resurface within 2 days. Lessons between 0.6-0.8 resurface within 5 days.

weeks.grammar_focus: Subject pronouns (ich, du, er/sie/es, wir, ihr, sie/Sie); sein and heißen in present tense
weeks.competency: User can introduce themselves, say hello/goodbye, and ask someone's name.

weeks.grammar_focus: Present tense of kommen, sein; question words (wo, woher, wie alt); word order in questions
weeks.competency: User can say where they are from, ask someone's age and origin, and use numbers 0-100.

weeks.grammar_focus: Possessive pronouns (mein, dein, sein, ihr); noun gender (der, die, das) introduction
weeks.competency: User can describe their family members and ask about someone else's family.

weeks.grammar_focus: Indefinite articles (ein, eine); negation with kein/keine; present tense regular verbs (arbeiten, lernen, studieren)
weeks.competency: User can state their occupation, ask what someone does for work, and negate statements.

vocab.definition: What do you do for a living?

weeks.grammar_focus: Definite articles (der, die, das) deepened; plural forms; basic sentence structure (SVO)
weeks.competency: User can identify common objects, ask what something is, and use correct articles for practiced nouns.

weeks.grammar_focus: Time expressions (am Montag, um drei Uhr, im Januar); separable verbs introduction (aufstehen, anfangen)
weeks.competency: User can tell time formally and informally, name days and months, and describe a simple daily schedule.

weeks.grammar_focus: Separable verbs in full (aufwachen, einkaufen, fernsehen, etc.); reflexive verbs introduction (sich waschen, sich anziehen)
weeks.competency: User can describe their daily routine from waking up to going to bed using separable and reflexive verbs.

weeks.grammar_focus: Accusative case introduction (direct objects: Ich esse einen Apfel); möchten (would like); gern/lieber/am liebsten
weeks.competency: User can order food, express preferences, and describe what they like to eat/drink using the accusative.

weeks.grammar_focus: Accusative case deepened (einen, eine, ein in accusative); demonstrative pronouns (dieser, diese, dieses); comparisons with zu + adjective
weeks.competency: User can ask prices, describe what they want to buy, and handle basic shopping conversations.

weeks.grammar_focus: Review: present tense (regular, irregular, separable), articles, accusative, possessives, negation, question formation
weeks.competency: User can hold a basic conversation covering all A1 topics: introduce self, describe family/work/routine, order food, shop, and tell time.

vocab.definition: How do you say... in German?

weeks.grammar_focus: Dative case introduction (in dem/im, auf dem); two-way prepositions with location (in, an, auf, neben, zwischen, etc.)
weeks.competency: User can describe their home, name rooms and furniture, and say where things are located using dative prepositions.

weeks.grammar_focus: Imperative mood (du/ihr/Sie forms); two-way prepositions with motion (accusative: in die, auf den); nach, zu + dative
weeks.competency: User can ask for and give directions, understand simple navigation instructions, and distinguish location vs. motion prepositions.

weeks.grammar_focus: Modal verbs deepened (können, müssen, wollen, dürfen, sollen); fahren + mit + dative
weeks.competency: User can discuss travel plans, buy tickets, and express ability/necessity/permission around transportation.

weeks.grammar_focus: Impersonal es constructions (es regnet, es gibt); wenn-clauses introduction (subordinate clause word order)
weeks.competency: User can describe the weather, talk about seasons, and form simple conditional sentences about weather.

weeks.grammar_focus: Adjective endings after definite articles (der rote Pullover, die blaue Jacke); colors; gefallen + dative
weeks.competency: User can describe what people are wearing, express opinions on appearance, and use correct adjective endings with definite articles.

weeks.grammar_focus: Dative case with body parts and verbs (wehtun, helfen, gehören); reflexive verbs deepened (sich fühlen, sich verletzen)
weeks.competency: User can describe symptoms, name body parts, and communicate at a doctor's office or pharmacy.

weeks.grammar_focus: Adjective endings after indefinite articles (ein roter Pullover); gern + verb; Interesse haben an + dative
weeks.competency: User can discuss hobbies, express likes and dislikes about activities, and invite someone to do something.

weeks.grammar_focus: Future with present tense + time expression; werden + infinitive (future tense); temporal prepositions (vor, nach, seit, bis)
weeks.competency: User can make appointments, suggest times, accept/decline invitations, and talk about future plans.

weeks.grammar_focus: Polite requests (Könnte ich...?, Ich hätte gern...); indirect questions (Können Sie mir sagen, wo...?); dative with verbs (schmecken, empfehlen)
weeks.competency: User can navigate a full restaurant experience: reserve a table, order, ask about dishes, complain politely, and pay.

weeks.grammar_focus: Perfekt with haben (regular: gemacht, gekauft; irregular: gegessen, getrunken); participle formation rules
weeks.competency: User can describe past events and activities using Perfekt with haben, including common irregular participles.

weeks.grammar_focus: Perfekt with sein (gefahren, gegangen, geworden); Präteritum of sein and haben (war, hatte); when to use Perfekt vs Präteritum
weeks.competency: User can narrate past events using both Perfekt (with sein and haben) and Präteritum for sein/haben.

weeks.grammar_focus: Review: dative case, two-way prepositions, adjective endings, Perfekt, Präteritum, modal verbs, future, subordinate clauses with wenn/weil
weeks.competency: User can handle everyday situations (housing, health, travel, restaurants), narrate past events, and express opinions with reasons.

vocab.definition: on one hand... on the other hand
I am of the opinion that...

weeks.grammar_focus: Subordinate clauses with dass, ob, weil, wenn (word order reinforcement); indirect speech introduction
weeks.competency: User can discuss their educational background, describe courses and subjects, and report what others said using dass-clauses.

weeks.grammar_focus: Relative clauses with der/die/das; genitive case introduction (des, der); compound nouns
weeks.competency: User can describe their work environment, discuss tasks and responsibilities, and use relative clauses to provide additional information.

weeks.grammar_focus: Passive voice present tense (wird gemacht); man as impersonal subject; verbs with prepositions (warten auf, sich freuen über)
weeks.competency: User can discuss technology use, describe processes using passive voice, and talk about media consumption.

weeks.grammar_focus: Konjunktiv II for politeness and wishes (wäre, hätte, würde + infinitive); als ob + Konjunktiv II
weeks.competency: User can express emotions, describe how they feel, make polite requests, and express hypothetical wishes.

weeks.grammar_focus: Präteritum of common verbs (ging, kam, sah, sprach, etc.); temporal conjunctions (als, nachdem, bevor, während); Plusquamperfekt
weeks.competency: User can narrate a sequence of past events using Präteritum and Plusquamperfekt, connecting them with temporal conjunctions.

weeks.grammar_focus: Passive voice past tense (wurde gemacht); n-Deklination (der Mensch, den Menschen); infinitive clauses with zu
weeks.competency: User can discuss environmental topics, describe nature, and express opinions about ecological issues using passive and infinitive clauses.

weeks.grammar_focus: Relative clauses with prepositions (die Stadt, in der...); genitive case deepened; pronominal adverbs (darüber, worauf, dafür)
weeks.competency: User can discuss cultural practices, describe holidays and traditions, and use complex relative clauses.

weeks.grammar_focus: Konjunktiv II deepened (conditional sentences: Wenn ich Zeit hätte, würde ich...); comparison (als, wie, je...desto)
weeks.competency: User can book accommodation, describe travel experiences, make comparisons, and discuss hypothetical travel plans.

vocab.definition: I would like to travel to...

weeks.grammar_focus: Verbs with fixed prepositions deepened (sich kümmern um, abhängen von, bestehen auf); da-/wo-compounds
weeks.competency: User can handle banking interactions, discuss financial matters, navigate basic German bureaucracy, and use prepositional verb constructions fluently.

weeks.grammar_focus: Passive with modal verbs (muss gemacht werden); Konjunktiv I introduction for reported speech (sei, habe); complex connectors (sowohl...als auch, weder...noch)
weeks.competency: User can understand and discuss news articles, report what others said, and express nuanced opinions on current events.

weeks.grammar_focus: um...zu + infinitive (purpose clauses); statt...zu, ohne...zu; lassen + infinitive
weeks.competency: User can discuss health goals, describe wellness routines, give and receive health advice, and express purpose.

weeks.grammar_focus: Concessive clauses (obwohl, trotzdem, dennoch); double infinitive constructions; subjunctive for advice (An deiner Stelle würde ich...)
weeks.competency: User can express and defend opinions, make concessions, give advice, and engage in structured debate.

weeks.grammar_focus: Review of werden + infinitive; Konjunktiv II for unreal conditions; temporal clauses with sobald, bis, solange
weeks.competency: User can discuss future plans and aspirations, describe hypothetical scenarios, and write about personal goals.

weeks.grammar_focus: Comprehensive review: all cases (Nom/Akk/Dat/Gen), all tenses (present, Perfekt, Präteritum, Plusquamperfekt, future), passive, Konjunktiv II, relative clauses, subordinate clauses, infinitive clauses
weeks.competency: User can participate in extended conversation on familiar topics, narrate experiences, express and justify opinions, and handle most everyday situations in a German-speaking country.

vocab.term: Ich bin stolz auf meinen Fortschritt
vocab.definition: I am proud of my progress
